steps.title: permission to make sound
steps.body:
For two minutes, play only the notes the keyboard marks: the key's pentatonic. Minor pentatonic in a minor key, major pentatonic in a major one.

The pentatonic leaves out the key's most tense notes, so it sits over the whole loop. The goal isn't a score: it's playing without fear. The drill counts notes outside the marks only so you can see how few there were.

- Start with long notes on the beat.
- Then leave space: two bars playing, two bars listening.
- Then try short repeated figures and move them around.
